# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not mentioned | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 9 of 10 = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five tools under one number. If each tool is counted separately, the result is 13 of 14 (≈92.9%). The outcome is the same either way: only GraphQL is missing.

## Nice-to-Have (does not affect the outcome)

The resume shows none of Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, or public speaking.

## Outcome

**Proceed.** At 90%, the mandatory match is above the 85% threshold.

**Gap to explore in interview:** GraphQL is the only missing mandatory skill. The candidate's REST API design experience suggests it could be learned quickly, so it's worth asking about any GraphQL exposure not listed on the resume.
